style.name: California Casual
style.definition: A relaxed, sunny mix of comfortable slipcovers, pale timber and handcrafted accents.
style.materials: washed oak; ivory cotton; rattan; limestone; muted blue
style.living: ivory deep slipcovered sofa; woven rattan armchair; oval pale-oak coffee table; oak media console; round oak four-seat table with four woven-back chairs; linen drum pendant
style.bed: washed-oak queen with linen headboard; white bedding and pale blue throw; oak nightstands with ceramic lamps
style.solarium: weathered teak outdoor sofa and armchair with ivory performance cushions; round teak four-seat dining set
style.implement: Keep curtains light and use a large woven rug to unify the shared room.
style.avoid: Avoid oversized sectionals that pinch the kitchen passage.
